faq.a: Afaan is associated with Somali. Afaan is Somali, meaning 'language, mouth'.
No — the underlying form is Somali, not Arabic.
Afaan can occur in Muslim naming contexts, but it is better described as a Somali-origin name used within some Muslim naming traditions than as an exclusively Islamic religious term.
